headline: Cross Is Out, the Trenches Walk, and Seattle Still Lays Three
text:
Monday morning conference call, one game left on the Week 8 board.

In The Trenches: Charles Cross is out. Josh Jones starts at left tackle. I'm off this one, side and total.

Next Man Up: I finally had company on Bears +3.

The number still says Seattle −3, total 46.5. One card off the table, zero flips. Inactives next. Unmute.
